card.name: Linking words in infection lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (commas, 'and', 'of', 'including', 'for', 'with') inside lists or phrases about named infections such as yaws, syphilis, cryptococcal or Candida infections.

modes.label: Between infection names
modes.description: A comma or 'and' joining names of treponemal or similar infections.

modes.label: Before infection details
modes.description: Linking words right before a named fungal infection or its severe form.
modes.example: Cryptococcal infections, including cases<< of>> fatal cryptococcal meningitis and disse

modes.label: Inside dose figures
modes.description: A digit inside a penicillin dose number for these infections.
